title: 2024 AMC 10B Problem 24
statement:
Let

\[ \begin{aligned} P(m) &= \frac{m}{2} + \frac{m^2}{4} \\ &\quad {}+ \frac{m^4}{8} + \frac{m^8}{8}. \end{aligned} \]

How many of the values of \(P(2022),\) \(P(2023),\) \(P(2024),\) and \(P(2025)\) are integers?

solutions.text: Put everything over \(8:\) \(P(m) = \dfrac{m^8 + m^4 + 2m^2 + 4m}{8}.\) If \(m\) is even, every term up top is divisible by \(8.\) If \(m\) is odd, then \(m^2 \equiv m^4 \equiv m^8 \equiv 1\) and \(4m \equiv 4 \pmod 8,\) so the numerator is \(1 + 1 + 2 + 4 = 8 \equiv 0 \pmod 8.\) Either way \(P(m)\) is an integer, so all \(4\) values are integers. Therefore, the answer is E.
hints: Over the common denominator \(8,\) \(P(m) = \dfrac{4m + 2m^2 + m^4 + m^8}{8}\)
Check \(4m + 2m^2 + m^4 + m^8 \pmod 8\) separately for even and odd \(m\)
